pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with high edge angularity and star-like projections. Dark contiguous regions exhibit sharp pixel gradients at boundaries, with a marked reduction in spatial area from the upper flank to the lower hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream negative space forming thin, interconnected pathways. Junction nodes are frequent, exhibiting variable pixel thickness that narrows toward the ventral and posterior regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane along the upper neck presenting a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile against the background pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical linear crease or indentation is visible traversing the mid-flank, causing a localized structural disruption in the pelage geometry.
